t: Pause Account Feature – Everything You Need to Know
html:
Temporarily stepping away from Eleva does not have to mean rebuilding your account later. The Pause Account Plan lets you retain core account data and configurations for $27/month while access to the platform is paused.

What is the Pause Account Feature

The Pause Account Feature is designed for Agency users who temporarily do not need an active Eleva subscription but want to preserve their core account setup and data. While the account is paused, Agency users and sub-accounts cannot actively access the platform, but supported data, settings, and configurations remain preserved for future reactivation. The Pause Account Plan costs $27 per month, and you can reactivate, change, or cancel the plan when needed.


Pausing is different from canceling your Eleva subscription. A canceled account enters a 90-day data-retention period, after which the Agency account, sub-accounts, and associated data are permanently deleted if the account is not reactivated. The Pause Account Plan is intended for users who want to step away temporarily while retaining supported account data.

What Happens When You Pause Your Account


During the pause period:


  • You and your sub-accounts will not have active access to the platform.

  • Your data, settings, and configurations will be securely preserved.

  • You can reactivate, change, or cancel your plan anytime.


When you reactivate, all your progress will be restored so you can continue right where you left off.

We retain your core business assets so your work remains intact.

What Is Not Included in the Pause Account Plan


Some Eleva services depend on active subscriptions, registrations, renewals, or external infrastructure and are not preserved in the same way as core account data. Reviewing these items before pausing can help you avoid unexpected service loss or additional setup after reactivation.


CategoryWhat Happens During the PauseWhat to Know
Phone NumbersPhone numbers are deleted 14 days after the account enters Paused statusDeleted phone numbers may need to be obtained or configured again after reactivation
A2P RegistrationA2P registrations are deleted 14 days after the account enters Paused statusMessaging registration may require additional setup after reactivation
Reselling SubscriptionsReselling subscriptions are automatically canceledYou must resubscribe to affected services after reactivating the Agency account
Marketplace SubscriptionsMarketplace subscriptions are automatically canceledCanceled subscriptions do not automatically resume after reactivation
SaaS SubscriptionsSaaS subscriptions are automatically canceledPausing the Agency account is different from pausing individual SaaS sub-accounts
DomainsUpcoming internal domain renewals fail while the account is pausedA domain that is not renewed can expire and may require recovery after reactivation

How to Pause Your Account


  1. From Agency View, go to Settings > Billing.



  2. Click Want to Modify/Cancel Your Subscription?



  3. Select the Pause Account option when presented.

How to Reactivate Your Paused Account


Reactivating your account is simple and takes just a few minutes.


  1. Go to the login page and sign in to your account.

  2. You’ll be presented with a Reactivate Account screen.

  3. Complete the payment process.

  4. Your account will immediately move from Paused to Active status.

Frequently Asked Questions


Q: Can my team or clients access Eleva while the Agency account is paused?

No. The Agency and its sub-accounts do not have active platform access while the account is paused. Client Portal access is also unavailable during this period.


Q: Do my workflows continue running while my Agency account is paused?

No. Published workflows and automations are moved to Draft when the account is paused. Their configurations remain preserved so they can be reviewed and republished after reactivation.


Q: Do canceled Marketplace, reselling, or SaaS subscriptions restart automatically after reactivation?

No. These subscriptions are automatically canceled when the Agency account is paused. You must resubscribe to any affected services you want to use after reactivation.
